contract.reuse_rule: Fresh lexical output must have no diagnostics and the same complete significant-token sequence, language profile, artifact kind, source-envelope schema, parser policy, profile registry, and syntax schemas as one integrity-checked valid cached parse.

behavior: Comment and whitespace edits freshly lex the current source and can reuse the previous valid syntax tree when significant tokens are identical.
Current lexical tokens and CST token indexes are rebuilt; AST, CST, and diagnostic spans are remapped to current byte offsets, lines, and Unicode columns.
Any missing, ambiguous, or unmappable span fails closed to a fresh parse; invalid parses are never reused across changed text.
A fresh parser API accepts the freshly lexed document so cache misses do not lex changed source a second time.

limitations: This evidence establishes Language parser work avoided and source-location correctness; it is not a wall-time or memory performance claim.
